name: Tainted Harmony: A Succubus's Embrace
source:
You live a happy, fulfilling life with your girlfriend, best friend, and guardian by your side, an almost perfect life. However, that perfection shatters when a succubus enters your world and begins to influence your life. Her influence taints the harmony between you and your loved ones. Will you be able to resist her seductive power, or will you succumb to temptation, embracing the darkness and spreading her corruption?

[From [url=https://rvdv.itch.io/tainted-harmony-a-succubuss-embrace]Itch[/url]]
translation:
你过着幸福、充实的生活，有女朋友、最好的朋友、监护人在身边，几乎是完美的生活。然而，当魅魔进入你的世界并开始影响你的生活时，这种完美就被打破了。她的影响破坏了你和你所爱的人之间的和谐。你能抗拒她的诱惑力量，还是屈服于诱惑，拥抱黑暗，传播她的腐败？

[来自[url=https://rvdv.itch.io/tainted-harmony-a-succubuss-embrace]Itch[/url]]
